text:
maria: Heads-up — hosted-usw2 pool tripped the circuit-breaker ~12:40 UTC. P95 queue latency hit ~22s and admission throttle climbed to ~60%. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/hosted-usw2-capacity (alert fired).

infra-bot: ALERT: pool=hosted-usw2 circuit-breaker=OPEN; reason=queueing_above_threshold; p95_queue_latency=22.1s; active_batches=480.

oncall-ops: I'm taking this. Reassigning to @noah for a metric deep-dive and to confirm scope.

noah: Pulling queries now. Any recent rollouts or config changes in us-west-2?

noah: PromQL snippets I'm running:```sum(rate(admission_requests_total{pool="hosted-usw2"}[1m])) by (route)``` and ```histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(queue_latency_seconds_bucket{pool="hosted-usw2"}[5m])) by (le))```

samir: Traffic looks dominated by embeddings route for customer alpha-corp — they're sending large batch sizes (200+) from a spike at ~12:35 UTC. Suggest temporary per-key throttling or overflow routing.

ashley: Also seeing image pull times spike on warmers. `kubectl get events --namespace=warmers` shows repeated registry timeouts; avg pull latency ~8s which compounds admission.

maria: Mitigation plan: 1) enable overflow routing for low-priority routes to eu-west-1, 2) scale hosted-usw2 pool by +4 GPU nodes, 3) apply temp rate-limit to customer alpha-corp API key. I'll apply 1 and 3 now.

maria: Overflow routing update: applied policy `route:low-priority -> overflow:eu-west-1` (will affect embeddings with priority=low).

deploy-bot: scale request accepted: pool=hosted-usw2 scale_delta=+4 GPUs (request_id=scale-1768880000-1). Estimated provisioning ETA ~6m.

oncall-ops: After overflow flip queue p95 dropped to ~7s and admission throttle down to ~20% — still trending. Monitoring. :eyes:

noah: Confirmed embedding batch sizes align with alpha-corp spikes. Their batch_size 200+ correlates with increased KV-cache misses; cache warmup looks poor for that workload.

samir: I'll open a quick PR to add per-customer backoff for heavy batchers and reduce max_batch_size default for embeddings route. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/prs/789 (work in progress).

ashley: For image pulls I'll kick the registry retry policy and roll the warmers pool to pick up newer image cache heuristics. Running: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/warmers-usw2`

maria: Current status summary (12:47 UTC): overflow -> eu-west-1 applied, scale +4 queued, alpha-corp throttled by 30%, warmers rolling. Metrics improving but not stable for 10m yet.

noah: Follow-ups: - add image-pull-time to the capacity dashboard with a heatmap overlay - make circuit-breaker consider image_pull_fraction metric (not just queue latency) - add per-route circuit-breaker knobs in runtime.

samir: Also propose a cheap telemetry tag on admission requests to mark large-batch origins so we can surface heavy senders in the dashboard. Will include in PR.

maria: Thanks all. Keep posting updates here — we'll close once p95 < 5s and admission throttle < 10% for 10m.

oncall-ops: Noted. If provisioning completes and metrics hold we'll run a retrospective on thresholds and cost tradeoffs (scale vs overflow). :thumbsup:
